name: Sthenoi
body:
Sthenoides are defined by class levels—they don’t have racial Hit Dice. Sthenoides have the following racial traits.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Standard +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, -2 Strength; sthenoides are resistant and fascinating but don’t like resorting to physical violence to protect themselves.
Type: Humanoid. Sthenoides are humanoid with the sthenoi subtype.
Size: Medium. Sthenoides are Medium creatures.
Speed: Normal Sthenoides have a base speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Standard Sthenoides begin play speaking Common. Sthenoides that have high Intelligence scores are able to choose from any of the following bonus languages: Aklo, Cyclops, Giant, Orc, or Sphinx.
Defense Racial Traits
Poison Resistance Sthenoides gain a racial bonus on saving throws against poison effects equal to their Hit Dice.
Unblockable Sthenoides are immune to paralysis and petrification effects.
Offense Racial Traits
Calcifying Gaze: Sthenoides inherited a tiny bit of the medusa’s petrifying magic. Once per day, they can partially petrify a Large or smaller creature’s legs, causing them to be entangled and stuck to the floor for 1 round (DC 14 Fortitude partial). A creature making its save has its speed halved for 1 round instead. A creature can break free with a DC 14 Strength check or by dealing 15 points of bludgeoning damage to the stone hindering its movement. The save DC is Charisma-based.
Magic Racial Traits
Snake Magic: Sthenoi bloodragers with the medusa bloodline or sorcerers with the serpentine bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Sthenoi clerics with the Scalykind domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level. This trait does not give a sthenoi early access to level-based powers; it only affects powers that she could already use without this trait.
Senses Racial Traits
Darkvision 60 ft.
Alternate Racial Traits
Freeze A sthenoi with this racial trait can hold itself so still they appears to be a statue. A sthenoi that uses freeze can take 20 on their Stealth check to hide in plain sight as a stone statue. This racial trait replaces unblockable.
Master Sculptor A sthenoi with this racial trait gains a +2 racial bonus on Craft skill checks to work stone or create stone items. This racial trait replaces darkvision, Venomous Bite As an extraordinary ability, some sthenoides gain a bite attack that deals 1d3 damage. A number of times per day equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), a sthenoi can deliver a paralytic venom with her bite, as follows. This racial trait replaces snake magic.
Bite—injury; save Fort DC 10 + the 1/2 user’s Hit Dice + the user’s Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str; cure 1 save.
Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist: Add +1 on Craft (alchemy) checks to craft poison and +1/3 on the DCs of poisons the alchemist creates.
Bloodrager: Add 1/2 to the bloodrager’s effective class level when determining the power of her bloodrager medusa bloodline powers.
Druid: Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence reptilian animals and magical beasts.
Fighter: Add +1 to the fighter’s CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.
Hunter: Add +1 to the effective level of the hunter’s animal companion when using the snake animal focus.
Oracle: Add 1/6 to the oracle’s level for the purpose of determining the effects of one revelation.
Ranger: The ranger’s animal companion gains a +1/2 resistance bonus on saving throws against poison. If the hunter replaces her animal companion, the new animal companion gains this bonus.
Rogue: The rogue gains +1/6 of a new rogue talent among the following: accurate poisoner, developed poison immunity, lasting poison, lingering poison, poison use, signature poison, suppress poison, swift poison.
Sorcerer: Add +1/2 to the number of times per day a sorcerer can use the serpent’s fang serpentine bloodline power. The sorcerer must possess the applicable power to select these bonuses.
Witch: Add 1/3 to the saving throw DC to resist the poison of the witch’s familiar.
Sthenoi Traits
Preternatural Awareness (Race Trait)

Requirement(s) Sthenoi

You partially inherited the medusa’s perceptivity. You gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks, and the flanking bonuses of creatures flanking you are reduced by 1.

Scaly Skin (Race Trait)

Requirement(s) Sthenoi

You sport minute scales on your body, protecting you from attacks. You gain a +1 trait bonus on your Armor Class when you are wearing no armor or shield.

Stone Sensitivity (Race Trait)

Requirement(s) Sthenoi

You can instinctively “feel” and “read” rock and stone.

You gain stonecunning, as the dwarf racial trait. This counts as stonecunning for all prerequisites.

Stone Singer (Race Trait)

Requirement(s) Sthenoi

You can command creatures made of stone. The DC of mind-affecting or language-dependent spells or effects you use increases by 1 against creatures with the earth subtype.

Sthenoi Feats
Animated Hair

You can command your hair as if it was made of actual snakes.

Prerequisite(s): Sthenoi.

Benefit(s): You can use the prehensile hair hex, using your character level as your witch or shaman level. If you have or later gain access to this hex through another source, you add 4 to your effective witch level for the purpose of using it.

Poisonous Blood

Your blood is toxic for those who spill it.

Prerequisite(s): Venomous bite racial trait, 5th-level character, sthenoi.

Benefit(s): Your blood is infused with the medusa’s venom.

Any creature that bites you or confirms a critical hit against you with a piercing or slashing melee weapon is subject to the effects of your poison.

Poisonous Pet

Your reptilian nature enabled you to befriend a snake pet.

Prerequisite(s): Sthenoi.

Benefit(s): You gain a snake familiar as per the arcane bond class feature, using your character level as your wizard level. This can be a viper or one of the serpentine creatures described in this book. If you have the ability to gain a familiar through other means and you are at least 5th level, the snake is instead treated as a serpentine improved familiar (such as a voidworm or a psyche serpent) as though you had taken the Improved Familiar feat. You can have only one familiar.

This feat can be taken a second time by a character of 7th level or higher if that character doesn’t otherwise have access to a familiar. Such characters treat their familiars as improved familiars, as described above.

Teeming Blood

From your blood, noxious vermin can be brought to life.

Prerequisite(s): 9th-level character, Poisonous Blood, sthenoi.

Benefit(s): Once per day when you suffered slashing or piercing damage in the previous round, you can summon a snake swarm from your spilled blood. This works as summon swarm (caster level equal to your character level). If you are not wounded, as an attack, you can inflict 1d6 points of slashing or …?
